LanguageData.VFEI_EmpressEvil.description: Empress Evil will tell a story of sorrow, misery and struggle, where a group of brave colonists face off against impossible odds. Good events will appear only after enduring extreme hardships, and will appear so sporadically, that you will celebrate even the smallest touch of serenity in the storm of evil.
LanguageData.VFEI_EmpressEvil.label: Empress Evil
LanguageData.VFEI_HanHordeMode.description: Han Horde-mode has served numerous tours on Sorne and cannot imagine a life without a worthy adversary. As such, his story will be that of the endless waves of insectoids crashing against the bulwark of the valiant defense. The insectoid waves will follow a regular pattern of low-to-high activity, and each defeated wave will reward you with technological progression.
LanguageData.VFEI_HanHordeMode.label: Han Horde-mode
